description: Draws the institutions that bought and sold the most shares of a stock or ETF in a quarter in the chat, from 13F filings: the largest changes as bars and both ranked lists, with a way into each holder's portfolio and to other quarters. Call it when the user asks who has been buying or selling a stock, or when that list is itself the answer. Show at most one card per answer. Never call it to collect data for your own analysis: where the chat app draws cards it answers with one line, not the rows. GetTopInstitutionalBuyersSellers returns the figures.

reportDate.description: Quarter-end 13F report date in YYYY-MM-DD format (default: the latest available).
